ai-emotional-support-users-chatbot-thera.headline: AI Emotional Support Users - Chatbot Therapy & Journaling
ai-emotional-support-users-chatbot-thera.author: Louise Gill
ai-emotional-support-users-chatbot-thera.core: Posted in last 7 days AI Emotional Support Users - Chatbot Therapy & Journaling Happy Monday everyone! I am becoming increasingly fascinated with how people are using AI for non-productivity means. I am currently working on an article about usage of software such as ChatGPT as a form of therapy, instant-response journalling or as a way to process emotions/events etc. I would really love to hear from anyone who has used AI to ask for advice, process emotions, analyse WhatsApp/message conversations, for support to structure live conversations with humans, or for anything else that is not related to work, health or general queries (recipes, how-tos etc.), or from anyone who knows someone who does this. I'm particularly interested in why people go to AI for these purposes. Anything shared with me would remain anonymous, and I would love to hear both positive and negative examples and anecdotes. You also do not have to share any of your AI chat threads or any specific details about what you you used the AI for (e.g. you don't need to tell me any details about your relationship doubts!). I'm also generally interested in people's thoughts on this. Please feel free to DM or email me, and a huge thank you in advance if you are interested in chatting about this. 😊 #ai #artificialintelligence #chatgpt #machinelearning #generativeai #techtrends #aitherapy #chatgpttherapy #aiethics
